appearances.title: Nous releases Arete-27B open weights
appearances.summary: Nous Research released Arete-27B, an Apache-2.0 supervised fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B, with weights, an 803-prompt values eval, and training data. On that eval, answers the lab classed as propaganda fell from 22% to 1%, while the Hermes Bench score stayed about the same.
